description: PostgreSQL-rendered definitions of the three decision tables' constraints and user triggers, and of the organization_factual_review_* functions, before and after migration 05, captured from a disposable loopback cluster built from the repository's normal migration chain (every migration before 05, in introduction order).

before.postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 16.14 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101), 64-bit

constraints.name: claim_review_decisions_p2_12_audience_scope_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((decision_outcome = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'approved_with_limitation'::text])) AND approved_audiences IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(approved_audiences) > 0 AND approved_audiences <@ ARRAY['internal'::text, 'funder'::text, 'public'::text] OR (decision_outcome <> ALL (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'approved_with_limitation'::text])) AND approved_audiences IS NULL)

constraints.name: claim_review_decisions_p2_12_claim_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, organization_id) REFERENCES kai.claims(claim_id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: claim_review_decisions_p2_12_limitation_notes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (decision_outcome = 'approved_with_limitation'::text AND limitation_notes IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(limitation_notes) > 0 AND kai.p2_12_all_array_entries_non_blank(limitation_notes) OR decision_outcome <> 'approved_with_limitation'::text AND limitation_notes IS NULL)

constraints.name: claim_review_decisions_p2_12_supersedes_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_decision_id, organization_id, claim_id) REFERENCES kai.claim_review_decisions(decision_id, organization_id, claim_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: coverage_review_decisions_p2_10_claim_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, organization_id) REFERENCES kai.claims(claim_id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: coverage_review_decisions_p2_10_gap_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, claim_id, dimension_key) REFERENCES kai.gap_log_items(organization_id, claim_id, dimension_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: evidence_review_decisions_p2_12_item_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (evidence_item_id, organization_id) REFERENCES kai.evidence_items(evidence_item_id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: evidence_review_decisions_p2_12_limitation_notes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (decision_outcome = 'supported_with_limitation'::text AND limitation_notes IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(limitation_notes) > 0 AND kai.p2_12_all_array_entries_non_blank(limitation_notes) OR decision_outcome <> 'supported_with_limitation'::text AND limitation_notes IS NULL)

constraints.name: evidence_review_decisions_p2_12_supersedes_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_decision_id, organization_id, evidence_item_id) REFERENCES kai.evidence_review_decisions(decision_id, organization_id, evidence_item_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: claim_review_decisions_p2_12_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER claim_review_decisions_p2_12_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON kai.claim_review_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kai.p2_12_reject_claim_review_decision_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_p2_10_coverage_review_decisions_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_p2_10_coverage_review_decisions_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON kai.coverage_review_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kai.p2_10_reject_coverage_decision_mutation()

triggers.name: evidence_review_decisions_p2_12_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER evidence_review_decisions_p2_12_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON kai.evidence_review_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kai.p2_12_reject_evidence_review_decision_mutation()

after.postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 16.14 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101), 64-bit

constraints.name: claim_review_decisions_organization_internal_audience_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (decided_by_role <> 'client_admin'::text OR approved_audiences IS NULL OR approved_audiences = ARRAY['internal'::text])
